name: Henan Carve Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Henan Carve Electronics Technology Co., Ltd., a Chinese enterprise, engages in the full spectrum of activities surrounding electronic precision cable connection components, from their initial research and development through manufacturing and ultimate distribution. The company's comprehensive product portfolio caters to a multitude of sectors. For security systems, it manufactures essential items such as power cables for IP cameras, audio/video cables for multi-function and dome cameras, fiber optic cables, wire harnesses, SATA cables, and various adapters. Its communication offerings include a broad range of connectivity solutions like DVI, VGA, AV, SCART, DisplayPort, aviation plug, network, USB, and HDMI cables. Furthermore, Henan Carve produces MFI-certified cables, available in braided with assembly shell, flat cable with adapter, molding, and assembly configurations. Complementary products encompass coaxial cables, connectors, and specialized items for the Tmall platform. These sophisticated components are vital to diverse applications across security monitoring, communication networks, medical electronics, rail transportation, industrial automation, and renewable energy. Established in 1999, the company maintains its principal office in Zhoukou, China.
